 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. It is expected that Matthis Abline will partner Paris Brunner in the AS Monaco attack this afternoon when Filipe Luís' side face Paris FC at the Stade Jean Bouin.
 Stanis Idumbo and Ansu Fati are the only injury-related absences for the Principality club. Mika Biereth has not made the matchday squad, but the Danish international is not injured.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement There is a return for Eric Dier, who has recovered from a minor muscle injury. However, it is not expected that he will start for Monaco. Instead, it is Jordan Teze who is expected to start alongside Sadibou Sané.
 Up front, Abline and Brunner are expected to lead the line. Folarin Balogun may once again have to settle for just a place on the bench.
 Monaco likely line-up v Paris FC
 Lukas Hradecky; Nazinho, Jordan Teze, Sadibou Sané, Vanderson; Aleksandr Golovin, Denis Zakaria, Lamine Camara; Edan Diop; Matthis Abline, Paris Brunner. (L'Éq)
 GFFN | Luke Entwistle
